tests.scope: ROI contract, round-2 counterexamples and prior targeted suites; not the entire repository

measurement_roi: coarse-mapped source valid tissue for U1; source parent 2 or 4 for U2; pixelwise equality required, including on baseline and both target doses
preservation_roi: union of four verified handoff joint_change masks, including full native footprints and normalized nuclei semantics; dilate by 8 and exclude from source valid tissue
evidence_output: cohort_roi_validation.json: denominator_pixels, shape, file_sha256 and binary_mask_sha256 for each ROI

ignore_policy.readout: 255 remains ignore; allowed outside fixed source ROI, rejected inside target measurement ROI; other unknown tissue labels rejected
ignore_policy.formal_generation: HTE accepts known IDs 0..15 only; 255 in source/target conditions is rejected before model invocation; no silent mask repainting

acceptance: complete five-state synthetic assets pass actual ledger, handoff, asset/environment preflight and cohort checks with explicit CPU model stubs
hash-correct cropped U1 and U2 ROI each stop before generation
protected ROI based on approved J passes, while inequivalent normalized raw-difference ROI fails
ignore outside readout ROI is accepted; inside is rejected; unsupported formal HTE condition IDs are rejected before generation
remaining: freeze approved targets, ROIs, patient/WSI mappings, overlap audits and strength definitions
accept the final joint two-operation/two-strength chain on excluded technical sources
only then open formal 30 WSI; physician study remains last
